Code Examples UMD

HTML + Auto-init Declarative setup via data attributes 
<link href="tee-skin-renderer.css" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="tee-skin-renderer.umd.js"></script>

<div class="tee"
     data-skin="https://ddstats.tw/skins/pinky.png"
     data-color-body="5498880"
     data-color-feet="3079936"
     data-eyes="happy"
     data-speed="10"
     data-follow-mouse="true">
</div>

<script>
  // Auto-initialize all .tee elements on the page
  TeeSkinRenderer.init();
</script>
Programmatic Create a tee with JS and append to DOM 
const container = await TeeSkinRenderer.createAsync({
  skinUrl: 'https://ddstats.tw/skins/pinky.png',
  colorBody: 5498880,
  colorFeet: 3079936,
  eyes: 'happy',
  speed: 10,
  followMouse: true,
});

document.body.appendChild(container);
Dynamic Properties Change skin, colors, eyes and animation at runtime 
const container = await TeeSkinRenderer.createAsync({
  skinUrl: 'https://ddstats.tw/skins/default.png',
});

// Access the renderer via container.tee
const tee = container.tee;

tee.skinUrl   = 'https://ddstats.tw/skins/pinky.png';
tee.colorBody = 16768387;
tee.colorFeet = 16777215;
tee.useCustomColor = true;
tee.eyes      = 'surprise';
tee.speed     = -20; // reverse leg animation
tee.inAir     = false;
tee.fat       = true;
Custom Keyframes A gentle hop built from normalized transform tracks 
const bounce = TeeSkinRenderer.animation.define({
  kind: 'keyframes',
  duration: 900,
  loop: true,
  easing: 'ease-in-out',
  tracks: {
    body: [
      { time: 0,   y: 0 }, { time: 0.2, y: 0 },
      { time: 0.5, y: -6 },
      { time: 0.8, y: 0 }, { time: 1,   y: 0 },
    ],
    backFoot: [
      { time: 0,   x: -7, y: 0 },
      { time: 0.2, x: -7, y: 0 },
      { time: 0.5, x: -6, y: -4, angle: -0.05 },
      { time: 0.8, x: -7, y: 0 },
      { time: 1,   x: -7, y: 0 },
    ],
    frontFoot: [
      { time: 0,   x: 7, y: 0 },
      { time: 0.2, x: 7, y: 0 },
      { time: 0.5, x: 6, y: -4, angle: 0.05 },
      { time: 0.8, x: 7, y: 0 },
      { time: 1,   x: 7, y: 0 },
    ],
    eyes: [{ time: 0, eyes: 'happy' }],
  },
});

const controller = tee.playAnimation(bounce);
controller.pause();
controller.resume();
controller.seek(400);
controller.stop();
Procedural Callback The same gentle hop calculated for every frame 
const hop = TeeSkinRenderer.animation.define({
  kind: 'callback',
  duration: 900,
  loop: true,
  frame({ progress, speed, inAir }) {
    const lift = Math.sin(progress * Math.PI) ** 2;
    return {
      body: { y: -5 * lift },
      backFoot: { x: -7 + lift, y: -3 * lift, angle: -0.04 * lift },
      frontFoot: { x: 7 - lift, y: -3 * lift, angle: 0.04 * lift },
      eyes: inAir || Math.abs(speed) > 19.5
        ? 'surprise'
        : 'happy',
    };
  },
});

const controller = tee.playAnimation(hop);
const result = await controller.finished;
console.log(result.reason);
Events React to skin loading and rendering 
const container = await TeeSkinRenderer.createAsync({
  skinUrl: 'https://ddstats.tw/skins/pinky.png',
  colorBody: 53063,
  colorFeet: 524159,
});

container.tee.addEventListener('tee:skin-loaded', (e) => {
  const { skin, success } = e.detail.payload;
  console.log(`Skin ${skin}: ${success ? 'loaded' : 'failed'}`);
});

container.tee.addEventListener('tee:rendered', (e) => {
  console.log('Tee rendered!');
});
Render to Canvas Export tee as a pixel-perfect canvas image 
const container = await TeeSkinRenderer.createAsync({
  skinUrl: 'https://ddstats.tw/skins/pinky.png',
  colorBody: 5498880,
  colorFeet: 3079936,
  speed: 10,
});

const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
container.tee.renderToCanvas(canvas, {
  size: 128,
  eyes: 'happy',
});

document.body.appendChild(canvas);
Sizing Control tee size with CSS font-size (base = 96em at 1px) 
/* Base tee is 96em × 96em.
   At font-size: 1px → 96px.
   Scale by changing font-size: */

.tee-xs  { font-size: 0.35px; }  /* 34px  */
.tee-sm  { font-size: 0.55px; }  /* 53px  */
.tee-md  { font-size: 1px;    }  /* 96px  (default) */
.tee-lg  { font-size: 1.6px;  }  /* 154px */
.tee-xl  { font-size: 2.2px;  }  /* 211px */

/* Or set it inline: */
<div class="tee" style="font-size: 1.5px"
     data-skin="..."></div>

/* Or dynamically via JS: */
container.style.fontSize = '2px';
Color Utilities Convert tee integer colors to HSL/RGBA 
const { color } = TeeSkinRenderer;

const teeColor = 5498880;

const hsl  = color.convertTeeColorToHsl(teeColor);
// [74.8, 100, 75.1]  = H, S%, L%

const rgba = color.convertTeeColorToRgba(teeColor);
// [127.5, 255, 0, 255]  = R, G, B, A
Eye Gallery All 7 eye types side by side

for (const eye of eyes) {
